title: Smart112Assessment
description: Contract schema for AI and heuristic triage evaluation of an emergency incident.

incident_id.description: Foreign UUID referencing the parent incident.

structured_facts.description: Detailed structured facts extracted from caller transcription and context.

casualty_count.description: Number of confirmed or estimated injured victims/casualties.

hazards.description: Identified active hazards (e.g. fire, fuel_leak, trapped_persons, weapons).

missing_information.description: Critical operational questions or details missing from initial report.

uncertainty_flags.description: Explicit warning flags identifying technical or factual uncertainty.

requires_human_review.description: Fail-safe indicator requiring mandatory human dispatcher triage.
